proposal.reason: Primary change adds new host one-sided RMA APIs (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal) and semantics that are not explicitly covered by a catalog module, so `other` is needed. `enqueue` is required for new RMA task validation/planning/scheduling and launch routing; `network` for GIN proxy plugin/loading/context/progress and cross-node RMA path; `copy-engine` for in-node CE-based RMA put/wait signal execution; `device-api` for symmetric-window/LSA registration and RMA window-handle integration; and `communicator` for numRmaCtx config parsing, capability negotiation, lifecycle/finalization, and async error plumbing.
